'''Chill pacs''' were items included in [[medkit]]s that were designed to treat swelling. The cooling technology inside a chill pac was activated by shaking it. [[Padija Anjeri]] treated [[Drake Paulsen]] with a chill pac to stop bruising on his face from getting worse.<ref name="II" />
